title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit225, 4-bit MLA latent KV, INT4 DFlash + 48 GB SSD KV
summary: Full GLM-5.3 (743B) on just two DGX Sparks (256 GB unified memory total) at TP=2 with upstream gr8: EXLR8 bit225 mixed-precision weights, 4-bit MLA latent KV (172K pool), native INT4 DFlash + MTP=1, and built-in 48 GB NVMe SSD KV store. Live-verified at RealMark 935.5 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 1,001.8 at C=4, 72.9 tok/s C=4 aggregate decode, 99.2% cache hit across 307K active context), 47.0 tok/s code decode, 443/418/369 tok/s cold prefill (8K/32K/128K), 128K needle PASS, and 0.686 GiB live MemAvailable floor.

configs.label: TP=2 · SSD KV

quality.name: RealMark RIPAL (C=1/2/4)
quality.value: 935.5 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 99.2% cache hit)

configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-28 on kindlingai/gr8 main (530312e6) across 2 DGX Sparks (256 GB unified memory total, 200G RoCE v2 switch), bit225 EXLR8 weights (501d2598), native INT4 DFlash (incoai/GLM-5.3-DFlash2 @ 425aa615, tp2-int4) + MTP=1, 4-bit MLA latent KV (CAP=172032, SESS=4), and 48 GB NVMe SSD KV_STORE with GR8_MEM_MIN=1. Decode, cold prefill (8K/32K/128K), concurrency (1/2/4), smoke (14/14), and 128K needle recall (131,046 tok) measured with gr8 bench/bench.py default level (GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages, 0% throttle). Official RealMark C=1/2/4 (Thinking OFF, --probe, default unthrottled stage): 935.5 Grade A (C=1 833.2 / C=2 980.9 / C=4 1,001.8; 26.1 / 40.5 / 72.9 tok/s aggregate decode; 16/16 done on all lanes; 99.23% prefix cache hit across 307K active C=4 context). Warm boot 86 s; live MemAvailable floor 0.686 GiB; 0 API errors; 0 OOMs.
